**Validator Name:** tanjira

**About:** Tanjira is the team behind GnoPulse, the indexing and analytics layer for gno.land. We run production infrastructure for the Gno ecosystem and validate across multiple networks.

**Networks:**
* Currently validating: AtomOne
* Former validator: Jackal, Passage

**Digital Presence:**
* Website: https://www.tanjira.com/
* Explorer: https://gnopulse.xyz
* X: https://x.com/TanjiraPr
* Discord: @jauziv, @tanjira_58334

**Contact:**
* Discord: @jauziv, @tanjira_58334
* Telegram: @tanjira_validator_official

**Why validate on gno.land:** We already build for gno.land daily. GnoPulse indexes the chain to power a public analytics dashboard, so we follow the network closely. Running a validator is the natural next step: helping secure the network we build tooling for, with skin in the game.

**Contributions to gno.land:** We build and operate GnoPulse (https://gnopulse.xyz), an indexer and analytics dashboard surfacing transactions, realms, accounts, balances, and onchain activity, with a developer API in development. We run hardened, monitored validator infrastructure and plan to contribute public infrastructure such as an archive node as the network matures.

* Profile & Infrastructure   * Website: https://trace-tm.tech   * Public Monitoring: https://monitoring.trace-tm.tech   * Custom Explorer: https://explorer.trace-tm.tech   * Infrastructure: We operate our own proprietary bare-metal servers with full hardware redundancy. This ensures maximum uptime and prevents the centralization risks associated with cloud providers \(AWS/GCP\). * Current Operations: Active validator in AtomOne, Juno, and CrossFi with a combined Total Value Locked (TVL) of over $350,000.  Why Gno.land\? Embracing the New Language Standard \"We are deeply committed to the evolution of blockchain-specific languages. While Go is the backbone of the Cosmos ecosystem, its non-deterministic elements have historically required complex workarounds. Gno.land’s deterministic interpreter represents a paradigm shift. By validating on Gno.land, we are not just supporting a network\; we are supporting the establishment of a new gold standard for smart contract development. We believe that Gno’s focus on readability, simplicity, and strict state management is the key to creating more secure and auditable decentralized applications. Our goal is to provide the high-performance infrastructure necessary to make this new standard a reality. " Contact & Socials   * Email: trace.valoper@gmail.com * Twitter: @vovscorp * Discord: @vovscorp * GitHub: vovscorp13

**Validator Name:**\
PlanTree \
PlanTree aims to give back to nature while following modern DevOps practices.\
Our infrastructure is distributed across several locations using bare-metal servers, 
some of which are partially powered by solar energy.\
A portion of validator revenue is redirected toward planting trees — making every delegator a contributor to environmental restoration.\
**Networks You Are Currently Validating:**\
AtomOne, Arkeo, Axone, IXO\
AuM: 70 000$\
**Links to Your Digital Presence:**\
Website: https://plantree.org \
Github: https://github.com/plantree-validator \
**Contacts:**\
Email: contact@plantree.org \
Discord: .upnp \
telegram: @belupnp \
**Why You Are Interested in Validating on gno.land:**\
We believe Gno-based smart contracts in combination with AtomOne can become attractive ecosystem to many applications around the world and the best way to speed up the adoption - support it! \
**Contributions to gno.land**\
We contribute by monitoring, snapshots, explorers, RPC endpoints, and related tooling.\
Already deployed explorer: \
https://gno-explorer.plantree.org/sapphire/ \
In the future, we hope to help build a web-based validator management tool to simplify node operations.
**server-type:** on-prem

**1. Validator name**
BonyNode

**2. Networks currently validating & AuM**
Professional node operator since 2017. 22 active validators across 50+ networks
(28+ mainnets, 22+ testnets) on dedicated bare-metal, including AtomOne.
AuM: ~$1M in delegations across all networks, largely from ecosystem developers.

**3. Digital presence**
Gno.land Topaz explorer (live): https://explorer.bonynode.online/gno
Website: https://bonynode.online/ | GitHub: https://github.com/BonyNode
X: https://x.com/bonynode | Telegram: https://t.me/bonynode
Discord: bonynode

**4. Contact**
Email: support@bonynode.online | Telegram: @bonynode | Discord: bonynode

**5. Why we want to validate on gno.land**
We already validate on AtomOne. Phase III of the Gno.land roadmap prioritises bridging
AtomOne and Gno.land over IBC/ICS, and the `10-gno` light client is already merged and
shipped on the AtomOne side - we want to be on both ends of that bridge when it lands.
Beyond that, Gno is the first chain where realms render their own UI, so an explorer can
show governance and the valoper registry natively rather than through a Cosmos skin.

**6. Contributions to gno.land**
- Public Topaz block explorer, live and free: https://explorer.bonynode.online/gno
  Built natively on Tendermint2 ABCI (vm/qrender, vm/qfuncs) against the official RPC -
  not a Cosmos-SDK skin. Shows blocks, live consensus round, the active valset with
  signing stats, a GovDAO tab with proposals and per-tier vote lists, the full
  r/gnops/valopers registry including operators still pending, and peer topology.
- Public Topaz RPC endpoint, free and open:
  https://gno-topaz-rpc.bonynode.online
- Committed to running it long-term and extending it as the chain evolves, including
  IBC views once AtomOne <-> Gno.land IBC lands.
- Infrastructure: dedicated bare-metal (server type: data-center, not cloud), 24/7
  on-call, archive-node storage sized for gno.land's no-pruning model.
